cliApiToken.description: Shared secret for CLI authentication. Auto-generated if not set. ENV: CLI_API_TOKEN

apiUrl.description: Hub URL for CLI connections. ENV: DUGONG_API_URL

extraHeaders.description: Extra headers for CLI to hub HTTP and WebSocket requests. ENV: DUGONG_EXTRA_HEADERS_JSON

listenHost.description: Hub HTTP bind address. ENV: DUGONG_LISTEN_HOST

publicUrl.description: Public URL for external access (e.g., Telegram Mini App). ENV: DUGONG_PUBLIC_URL

telegramBotToken.description: Telegram Bot API token from @BotFather. ENV: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN

serverChanSendKey.description: ServerChan SendKey for WeChat push notifications. ENV: SERVERCHAN_SENDKEY

serverChanBackgroundOnly.description: Only send ServerChan notifications when no visible dugong connection exists in the namespace. ENV: SERVERCHAN_BACKGROUND_ONLY

relayAuthKey.description: Per-hub relay auth key issued by the relay server. Auto-obtained if not set. ENV: DUGONG_RELAY_AUTH

vapidKeys.description: Auto-generated Web Push VAPID keys. Do not edit manually.

machineId.description: Auto-generated unique machine identifier. Do not edit manually.

machineIdConfirmedByServer.description: Internal flag. Do not edit manually.

runnerAutoStartWhenRunningHappy.description: Auto-start the runner when running a dugong command.

providerCredentials.description: Hub-managed voice and dictation provider credentials; process environment variables win over settings-backed values.

gitHostTokens.description: Access tokens for Git hosts, keyed by hostname (for example github.com), used to open pull requests. Set them under Settings > Git hosts.

sessionSummaryContract.description: Ask supported agents to end each turn with a one-line AGENT_NOTIFY_SUMMARY.

sessionSummaryInChat.description: Show the AGENT_NOTIFY_SUMMARY line in the web chat.
